courses.subject: BBMS
courses.title: MSc Project
courses.description: Students will be required to do a project or a literature survey and/or a mini research on a current topic in biochemistry or biomedical sciences under the supervision of a teaching staff of Department of Biochemistry.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Biochem & Biomedical Sci
courses.learning_outcomes:
Upon successful completion of this course, students should:
1) Be knowledgeable in the field and pursue life-long learning in practice.
2) Be able to well-planned experiments to test hypothesis using the scientific method approach.
3) Be able to carefully execute experiments with suitable skills.
4) Be able to analyze data with good interpretation using statistical skills.
5) Be able to evaluate its outcome and report the results in a professional manner with a precise and accurate summary.
6) Be able to synthesis of knowledge and produce new applications.
7) Be able to communicate effectively and professionally both in writing and by means of presentations to both specialist and a general audience.
8) Demonstrate a commitment to professional integrity and ethical behavior consistent with the missions of the university and accepted standards of professional conduct.
courses.course_syllabus: Perform a mini research project or a literature survey on a current biochemistry or biomedical science topic under supervision.
